summary.text: Ruth Hardy is a Democratic member of the Vermont State Senate for the Addison District, which she has represented since January 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hardy succeeded Claire Ayer in the Addison District seat.
In the 2019-2020 session she served on the Senate Education Committee and was clerk of the Agriculture Committee.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Finance Committee and the Natural Resources and Energy Committee, as well as the Judicial Retention Committee and the Canvassing Committee, which she co-chairs.
